title: Make Rust Piece Movement Methods
description: Refactor compose/rs so drag, move, and fix are piece methods. Drag must invalidate center cache of child pieces. Move must invalidate plane cache of child pieces. Fix must take the flat pose, remove the parent connection, set pose to children, and remove child connections. Extend existing Rust tests only and make tests pass.
summary: Refactored compose/rs movement operations so KitStore drag_pieces, move_pieces, and fix_pieces resolve target pieces and delegate to PieceStore methods. Added PieceStore drag, r#move, and fix methods under a PieceMovement region. Drag updates fixed centers or parent connection offsets and invalidates descendant center caches; move translates the piece plane and invalidates descendant plane caches; fix captures the current flat pose without self-lock recursion, detaches the parent connection, writes flat poses to immediate children, removes child connections, and invalidates design aggregates. Extended the existing Rust flatten tests with drag, move, and fix regression coverage. Verified with cargo test in compose/rs: 90 tests passed plus doc-tests.
